channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Amazon to lay off 16,000 and close Amazon Fresh stores
item.description: Amazon announced Tuesday it would close all of its brick-and-mortar Amazon Fresh and Amazon Go stores, with plans to convert some locations into Whole Foods.

item.title: Corruption case against L.A. Councilmember Curren Price can move to trial, judge rules
item.description: A Los Angeles County judge ruled Wednesday that there is enough evidence to take L.A. City Councilman Curren Price to trial on embezzlement, perjury and conflict of interest charges.

item.title: They said Katie Porter was dead politically. I checked her pulse
item.description: A one-two punch of unflattering videos caused many to write off Porter's gubernatorial candidacy. But the former O.C. congresswoman remains a top contender.

item.title: 'Finally, a renter's market': L.A. rent prices drop to four-year low
item.description: In December, L.A.-area rent prices hit a four-year low, while apartment vacancy rates hit a nearly five-year high, signaling a potential renter's market in some neighborhoods.

item.title: Warehouse building blaze triggers explosions, prompts massive firefighting response
item.description: Residents in South El Monte were ordered to shelter in place Wednesday afternoon as firefighters worked to battle a massive blaze at a warehouse complex.

item.title: Costco's $4.99 rotisserie chicken gets roasted in lawsuit. Here's what they're claiming
item.description: Fans of Costco's $4.99 rotisserie chicken may be alarmed to learn that the budget friendly grocery staple is facing a class action legal complaint for allegedly falsely advertising the item as being free from preservatives.

item.title: Tense exchange between LAPD deputy chief and vocal police critic goes viral
item.description: In a video clip that has circulated widely online, Deputy Chief Alan Hamilton is heard making allegations against activist Jason Reedy during a Martin Luther King Jr. Day event.

item.title: Bovino was the face of Trump's hardline immigration raids. Now his future is in question
item.description: Gregory Bovino's future is now in limbo as public outrage has swelled against the Trump's administration's aggressive tactics, particularly in Minnesota. But will his departure really change the administration's playbook?

item.title: Top Trump officials' reversal on Minneapolis shooting: Policy change or damage control?
item.description: Key Republicans' retreat from their blanket defense of federal agents who fatally shot a U.S. citizen in Minnesota is part of a larger effort by the White House.

item.title: UCLA medical school uses a 'systemically racist approach' to admissions, DOJ alleges
item.description: The Trump administration on Wednesday sought to join a federal lawsuit alleging that UCLA's David Geffen School of Medicine illegally considers race in admissions.
